Krator biome — the Throne: the cloud forest
Krator biome kit — the Throne, station 5: the cloud forest, the windward cloud belt ~3 km up the west flank (Cfb, the cloud most days). The elfin woods: gnarled, dwarfed trees cushioned and hung with moss, tree ferns, bromeliads in the forks, a floor of moss and ferns; the veil trees (Krator's own) combing the water from the cloud, their veils glowing at night; the ravine of the falls stepping down in four falls into plunge pools; the old rift ridge with the cloud pouring over its crest onto the drier heath beyond; the natives' trail and its cairns over the saddle (ideal type) · the weather picker: fog, drizzle, a clear spell · N night · click to inspect · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · right-drag / WASD to move
